posteriorSoftPalate.role: Authored posterior soft-palate and integrated uvular tissue only
posteriorSoftPalate.anteriorContext: Retained upper gingival source includes palatal mucosal surface; no hard-palatal bone claim
posteriorSoftPalate.attachmentMethod: Actual upward BVH mucosal hits; 1.5-mm anterior overlap strip; 0.05-mm inward embedding
posteriorSoftPalate.thicknessMethod: Superior graph offset, checked by local normal projection; no normal-offset fold

deformationGrid.ordering: lower grid row-major, then upper; u=(index%verticesPerLayer)//(nv+1)/nu

limitations: Narrow intentional overlap is not a measured histological junction
Lateral pharyngeal pillars and nasal/pharyngeal closure are absent
New topology requires fresh velum morphs, UVs and contact checks
